heading: Definitions
lead: In sections 430f–6 to 430f–12 of this title:

tree.heading: Map
tree.text: The term “Map” means the map entitled “Park Boundary-Corinth Unit”, numbered 304A/80009, and dated April 2007.

tree.heading: Park
tree.text: The term “Park” means the Shiloh National Military Park.

tree.heading: Secretary
tree.text: The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of the Interior.

tree.heading: Unit
tree.text: The term “Unit” means the Corinth Unit of Shiloh National Military Park established under section 430f–8 of this title.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2007—Par. (1). Pub. L. 110–161 substituted “304A/80009, and dated April 2007” for “304/80,007, and dated October 1998”.
